node.title: The q=3170 endpoint forces 339 rich planes and 217 saturated lines
node.closure: endpoint-plane recurrence, balanced plane incidence, and saturated-line extraction
node.statement: In the scalar-dimension-three quotient pair-pencil branch at the extremal population q=3170, the residual dimension lies in 4960..4982. The full-owner coordinate floor and the 218-plane endpoint shortening force between 339 and 358 distinct 218-point affine owner planes. A balanced point-plane incidence count forces at least 22752 pairs of those planes to meet in a saturated 15-point selected line, hence at least 217 distinct saturated lines. Every such line has at least K'-2609>=2351 residual common-core coordinates. No endpoint row is excluded or paid.
